title: An amazing day on the Med
text: An amazing day on the Mediterranean. Booking with Joan could not have been easier and more of a pleasure. Captain Liz gave my wife and me a day we will never forget. From finding the perfect spot to swim to taking us into a port for lunch to making sure we had champagne and snacks and beers and were comfortable at all times. Barcelona sailboats should be the only option for a boat in Barcelona and ask for captain Liz!
